GreymaneInnerBeastWolfheart.name: Wolfheart
GreymaneInnerBeastWolfheart.description: Increase the cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks during Inner Beast from 0.5 to 1.2 seconds.

GreymaneGilneanCocktailPerfectAim.name: Perfect Aim
GreymaneGilneanCocktailPerfectAim.description: Increases Gilnean Cocktail's range by 30% and refunds 45 Mana if it hits an enemy Hero.

GreymaneInnerBeastViciousness.name: Viciousness
GreymaneInnerBeastViciousness.description: Increases Inner Beast's duration to 4 seconds, and causes Ability damage to also refresh its duration.

GreymaneDarkflightThickSkin.name: Thick Skin
GreymaneDarkflightThickSkin.description: Using Darkflight grants 50 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks while in Worgen Form, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

GreymaneInnerBeastInsatiable.name: Insatiable
GreymaneInnerBeastInsatiable.description: Inner Beast causes Basic Attacks to restore 10 Mana, and reduce the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 0.5 seconds.

GreymaneWorgenFormQuicksilverBullets.name: Quicksilver Bullets
GreymaneWorgenFormQuicksilverBullets.description: Increases Greymane's Human Basic Attack range by 1.1.

GreymaneGilneanCocktailIncendiaryElixir.name: Incendiary Elixir
GreymaneGilneanCocktailIncendiaryElixir.description: Quest: Reduce the cooldown of Gilnean Cocktail by 2 seconds. Every time Greymane hits an enemy Hero with the explosion damage from Gilnean Cocktail, increase its explosion damage by 25, up to 375. Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, the cooldown is reduced by an additional 3 seconds

GreymaneWizenedDuelist.name: Wizened Duelist
GreymaneWizenedDuelist.description: Quest: Every 6 Human Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Basic Attack damage by 1%, up to 30%. Worgen Basic Attacks grant credit for 3 Basic Attacks. Half of this bonus is lost upon death.

GreymaneHeroicAbilityGoForTheThroat.name: Go for the Throat
GreymaneHeroicAbilityGoForTheThroat.description: Leap at an enemy Hero and shapeshift into a Worgen, slashing for 355 (+4% per level) damage. If this kills them, the Ability can be used a second time within 10 seconds for free.

GreymaneHeroicAbilityCursedBullet.name: Cursed Bullet
GreymaneHeroicAbilityCursedBullet.description: Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage. Does not affect Vehicles.

GreymaneDarkflightDisengageRunningWild.name: Running Wild
GreymaneDarkflightDisengageRunningWild.description: Increases Darkflight and Disengage's range by 35%, and reduce their cooldowns by 1 second.

GreymaneRazorSwipeUnfetteredAssault.name: Unfettered Assault
GreymaneRazorSwipeUnfetteredAssault.description: Increases Razor Swipe's lunge distance by 60%, and Worgen Basic Attacks reduce Razor Swipe's cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

GreymaneInnerBeastOnTheProwl.name: On the Prowl
GreymaneInnerBeastOnTheProwl.description: Inner Beast increases Movement Speed by 30% once it has been active for 3 seconds.

GreymaneEagerWolf.name: Eager Wolf
GreymaneEagerWolf.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Inner Beast by an additional 40% after it has been active for 4 seconds.

HeroGenericExecutionerPassive.name: Executioner
HeroGenericExecutionerPassive.description: Attacking a Hero that is slowed, rooted, or stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

GreymaneWorgenFormAlphaKiller.name: Alpha Killer
GreymaneWorgenFormAlphaKiller.description: Worgen Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 3% of the Hero's maximum Health.

GreymaneGoForTheThroatUnleashed.name: Unleashed
GreymaneGoForTheThroatUnleashed.description: Passive: Go For The Throat's damage is increased by 25%. If Go for the Throat kills its target, refund its Mana cost and reset the cooldowns of Greymane's Abilities.

GreymaneCursedBulletGilneanRoulette.name: Gilnean Roulette
GreymaneCursedBulletGilneanRoulette.description: Cursed Bullet's damage is reduced to 30% of current health but its cooldown is reduced by 24 seconds.

GreymaneHuntersBlunderbuss.name: Hunter's Blunderbuss
GreymaneHuntersBlunderbuss.description: Human Basic Attacks splash for 100% damage behind the target.

GreymaneToothAndClaw.name: Tooth and Claw
GreymaneToothAndClaw.description: Worgen Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage. Increase Razor Swipe's damage by 100%.
